Sorry, that's not correct.

Number of boys participated in only
Drama = 1820 x 0.10 = 182
Number of boys participated in both Drama and Dance = 1820 x 0.20 = 364
Number of boys participated in all three events = 1820/7 = 260
Thus, Number of boys participated in only Drama and Dance = 364 – 260 = 104
Number of boys participated in both Dance and Fashion Show = 1820 x 0.15 = 273
Thus, Number of boys participated in only Dance and Fashion Show = 273 – 260 = 13

properties.html: Anil, Sunil, and Ravi run along a circular path of length 3 km, starting from the same point at the same time, and going in the clockwise direction. If they run at speeds of 15 km/hr, 10 km/hr, and 8 km/hr, respectively, how much distance in km will Ravi have run when Anil and Sunil meet again for the first time at the starting point?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

We are given the individual speeds of Anil, Sunil and Ravi, which are 15 kmph, 10 kmph and 8 kmph respectively.
We are also told that the length of the track is 3 KM. Let us calculate the time taken by Anil and Sunil to complete one round(which is 3KM in length) :
Time taken by Anil to complete one round in minutes = (Length of the track in km/Anil’s speed in kmph) x 60 minutes = (3/15) x 60 = 12 minutes.
Time taken by Sunil to complete one round in minutes = (3/10) x 60 = 18 minutes.
Anil completing each round in 12 minutes, reaches the starting point at 12, 24, 36, 48, 60.... minutes Sunil completing each round in 18 minutes, reaches the starting point at 18, 36, 54, 72, 90.... minutes Clearly, both of them reach the starting point at 36 minutes, for the first time together.
Observe that 36 is the LCM of 12 and 18 The distance covered by Ravi, whose speed is 8 kmph in 36 minutes or 0.6 hrs = 8 x 0.6 = 4.8 km

W : M = 1 : 2
M : C = 3 : 1

The ratio of efficiency man : women : child = 6 : 3 : 2 Ratio of men : women : child = 4 : 3 : 2
Number of men, women, and children = 28, 21, 14
∴ The ratio of work done by 28 men, 21 women, and 14 children = (28 x 6) : (21 x 3) : (14 x 2) = 168 : 63 : 28
Hence Rs.23310 would be divided by this ratio. Amount for children = 90 x 28 = 2520 The wage of a child is equal to 2520/14 = Rs 180

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

The average score of the last 2 innings = (38 + 15)/2 = 26.5
The average of the first n innings = 30
The average of all the n + 2 innings = 29
29(n + 2) = n(30) + 2(26.5)
n = 5 (You may choose to use the allegation method too)
The average of the first 5 innings = 30 and in none of the innings did the batsman score 38 or above.
Let’s assume the scores of the 5 innings of the batsman in ascending order to be 30, 30, 30, 30, 30. (This complies with the average being 30)
The maximum score that he can score is 37 runs, Let’s distribute the score of the first innings among the rest 4, as 7 per innings so that the score of the first innings is minimized.
Now the scores will be 2, 37, 37, 37, 37
Now we can’t distribute the score of the first innings anymore, because that makes the score of at least one of the remaining 4 overs 38 or greater.

description.text: Find the difference of two natural numbers such that while finding their HCF by division method, in the last step the divisor is 6. The quotients, we obtained on division steps are 8, 4, 5 and 3 in the order from the beginning to the end.

properties.html: Find the difference of two natural numbers such that while finding their HCF by division method, in the last step the divisor is 6. The quotients, we obtained on division steps are 8, 4, 5 and 3 in the order from the beginning to the end.

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

Dividend = Divisor * Quotient + Remainder By using the HCF method, in the last step the remainder is zero and the divisor of any step is the remainder of the previous step and also the dividend at any step is the divisor of the previous step.
Last step dividend = 6 x 3 + 0 = 18
Second last dividend = 18 x 5 + 6 = 96
Third last dividend = 96 x 4 + 18 = 402
Fourth last dividend = 402 x 8 + 96 = 3312
So the numbers are 402 and 3312
the required difference between the numbers are 3312 – 402 = 2910.

properties.html: A larger cube is painted with black colour on all its faces. It is then cut into 343 identical cubes of equal sizes. How many of the smaller cubes will have at least two of its faces painted?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

The number of smaller cubes = 343 = 73 = 7 x 7 x 7 According to the formula,
The number of cubes with two sides painted
= 12 x (C – 2)
Where C denotes the number of cubes (smaller) that forms one edge of the larger cube. So, in this case, The number of cubes with two sides painted
= 12 x (7 – 2) = 60
Similarly, the number of smaller cubes with three sides painted = 8 (the number of cubes that forms the vertices of the larger cube)
So, the number of cubes with at least two sides painted = 60 + 8 = 68.
